verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own CHKit tooling is described as typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, "infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI". That is a first-party headless/CI capability, and the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface let standard clients and drivers script against it unchanged. However, the CI claim appears only as homepage marketing copy, with no docs page detailing CHKit commands or CI setup. Missing for 10: CHKit CLI reference docs, CI pipeline examples/integrations, non-interactive auth (service tokens) for CI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
